=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:606-800 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In single_pass_gate, the no-marker branch at lines 758-766 calls `single_pass_inherited_clean` (lines 606-649, merged in by 61a8f8ef) before the #9533 `single_pass_base_sync_carry` branch at lines 788-800/794-800. A marker-less base-sync head is therefore accepted as `reason=freshness_sync_inherited` without the carry's checks: local parents, single merge base, equal changed-file sets, and `-U0` `git patch-id --verbatim` equality. It also never logs `reason=base_sync_carry from=<sha>`.
  WHY: The checks are skipped in production because `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` contains `review_head_gate.sh`/`gh_helpers.sh`, so `SECURITY_PASS_BASE_SYNC_CARRY_ENABLED=false` does not stop inheritance and the README/changelog/agents.d contract is broken. When inheritance fails, `review_head_gate_freshness_sync` runs twice (§14). The carry tests pass only because `_run` stages a support dir without the helpers, which makes `single_pass_inherited_clean` return 1 at line 610. All reviewers rated it MAJOR, mapped here to high. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite cited line 785.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: "In `single_pass_gate`, treat the current head as clean when [the newest trusted `ai:merge-base-sync:v1` marker names this head as `merge=`, its `from=` head has a `status=clean` marker, the update commit's first parent is `from=`, and the diff restricted to the PR's changed files is a pure merge of main]. ... Log `single_pass_log … outcome=clean reason=base_sync_carry from=<sha>`."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh, single_pass_gate, the no-marker branch at lines 758-766 (vs. the carry branch at 788-800)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: On a base-synced head with no marker, production decides through `single_pass_inherited_clean` (merge commit 61a8f8ef), which logs `reason=freshness_sync_inherited`. That verifier checks the marker, signed merge parents and base ancestry, but not the local merge diff or patch IDs, so neither the specified pure-merge check nor the `reason=base_sync_carry` line is delivered on that path. The stricter `single_pass_base_sync_carry` at lines 794-800 is reached only afterwards.
- requirement: "The tests above are red on base and green on the change." / the tests for single_pass_base_sync_carry should exercise the logic as it would run in production.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py, `_run` / `_carry_run` support-dir staging (lines 170-174, 175-200)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The carry tests leave `review_head_gate.sh` and `gh_helpers.sh` out of the staged `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` (tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py lines 170-174), so the earlier inherited-clean path is unavailable in those tests and no test covers the merged production order. The `_inherit_run` tests at lines 1417-1420 do stage the helper.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:single_pass_gate, lines 758-766 (`if [ -z "${latest}" ]` calls `single_pass_inherited_clean`, merged in from main by 61a8f8ef) run before lines 794-800 (`single_pass_base_sync_carry`, the #9533 carry). See also `single_pass_inherited_clean`, lines 606-649. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A head with no marker (the normal state right after a pipeline base sync) is decided first by `single_pass_inherited_clean`. That function accepts the head once `from=` has a clean marker and checks nothing locally: not head^1/head^2, not a single merge base, not changed-file set equality, not `-U0` `git patch-id --verbatim`. It logs `reason=freshness_sync_inherited from=… hops=…`. The carry runs only on a stale `pending` marker or after inheritance fails, and in that second case it repeats `review_head_gate_freshness_sync`, reading `commits/<head>`/`compare` twice (§14).
  WHY: The kill switch `SECURITY_PASS_BASE_SYNC_CARRY_ENABLED=false` does not stop the inheritance path, and the README/changelog promise of a patch-id equality check is not applied on the common path. `test_base_sync_carry_kill_switch` and `test_base_sync_carries_the_clean_audit_of_a_pure_merge` pass only because `_run` stages a support dir (lines 175-200) without `review_head_gate.sh`/`gh_helpers.sh`, so `single_pass_inherited_clean` returns 1 at line 610. The reviewer's minimal fix: call the carry before inheritance, reword the README/changelog, and stage the helpers in the carry tests.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "In `single_pass_gate`, treat the current head as clean when [the newest trusted merge-base-sync marker names this head as merge=; from= is status=clean; the first parent is from=; the diff restricted to the PR's changed files is a pure merge of main] ... Log `single_pass_log … outcome=clean reason=base_sync_carry from=<sha>`", and "The tests above are red on base and green on the change."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh, single_pass_gate, the no-marker branch at lines 758-766; tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py, `_run` / `_carry_run` support-dir staging.
  Evidence of absence: Production decides a marker-less base-synced head through `single_pass_inherited_clean`, which has no pure-merge diff check and never emits `reason=base_sync_carry`. The carry tests leave `review_head_gate.sh` out of `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR`.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh, single_pass_base_sync_carry, the `carry_dir="$(cd "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" ...)"` lookup
  PROBLEM: The carry finds `review_head_gate.sh` next to the running script, while `single_pass_inherited_clean` pins it to `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR`, so the two verifiers can source different copies of the helper.
  WHY: Suggested fix is to use `${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR}` when it is set and contains both helpers, otherwise fall back to the script's own directory (about 2 lines); HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
